title: Mathematical models for CAR T immunotherapy and CD19 dynamics in leukemia: a comparative analysis
summary: Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T cell therapy has emerged as a successful treatment for relapsed or refractory hematological malignancies, particularly for B cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (B ALL), where CD19 targeted therapies have achieved high initial remission rates. However, relapse after treatment remains a major clinical challenge, frequently associated with antigen escape mechanisms and the emergence of CD19$^-$ leukemic cells.
